record.title: Validate the pinned guest step profile and observe two-word storage
record.intent: Test code-4 step stops with private controls before the unchanged bounded stock composition observation.
requirements: Preserve the prior code-2 rejection as immutable evidence; use a fresh disposable guest.
Expect code 4 only for single-step stops in the pinned guest profile; retain all PC and instruction checks.
Keep two fixed responses, the 256-step budget and the stop before the converter call.
Preserve stock APK and library bytes; no physical instrument or host-policy changes.
Stop and evaluate unexpected evidence rather than extending the run to obtain the predicted value.
acceptance: Pin the profile, runtime source snapshot and stock inputs.
Require all four access controls and both two-word controls to pass before stock responses.
Record and independently verify either the stock global store and pre-converter stop or a bounded negative outcome.
Verify stable system_server, unchanged stock artifacts and guest teardown.
